notes.zh: 仅当接收国尚无同物种、同来源国的难民旗标（refugeespecies@/refugeecountry@）时才出现；否则改发隐藏的 refugees.2，只显示一条消息，且同一物种4个月内不再提示。
notes.en: Shown only when the receiving empire has no refugee flags for the same species and origin country (refugeespecies@ / refugeecountry@); otherwise hidden refugees.2 is used, which only sends a message and suppresses the same species for 4 months.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现摧毁难民家园的危机名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the crisis that drove the refugees out appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现发动攻势一方的形容词形式。
note.en: In the game, the adjective of the side that launched the onslaught appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现难民逃离的前帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the former empire the refugees fled appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现该族群的形容词形式。
note.en: In the game, the adjective of that people appears here.
